subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support receiving non-mention Space messages, and if so should that be implemented through user OAuth, app-auth with admin approval, Workspace Events, polling/listing, or another approved credential/event model?
rationale: The remaining request changes Google Chat message visibility, OAuth or app-auth scopes, credential storage, consent/admin approval, and webhook/event ingestion semantics, which automation can verify as missing but cannot choose safely.

options.title: Split And Approve Design First
options.body: Keep this issue open, finish the thread work separately, and require a maintainer-approved Google Chat auth/event design before implementation.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local All-Message Mode
options.body: Add SecretRef-aware user OAuth or approved app-auth credentials plus documented all-message ingestion while preserving service-account webhook behavior by default.

options.title: Defer All-Message Ingestion
options.body: Keep Google Chat service-account and mention-gated for now, and close or narrow this issue only after thread support has a separate landed path.

recommendation.title: Split And Approve Design First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, finish the thread work separately, and require a maintainer-approved Google Chat auth/event design before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of recent Google Chat code history and maintainer-side review context for the auth/thread boundary.
